note: Scheduled jobs and rules. Usually edited on the Jobs page (Schedules and Rules); this file can also be edited by hand, then press Reload. Each schedule runs a job kind (src-tauri/src/job_kinds.rs) with its input: command (script, folder) or ai (provider: ollama, llama_cpp, claude_code, codex or grok_build; model; prompt; folder; endpoint). when: manual (only Run now or a rule), once (at), every (interval: 30s, 10m, 2h, 14d), daily (time), weekly (day, time) or monthly (day 1 to 31, time). Times are local: HH:MM and YYYY-MM-DD HH:MM. Optional: enabled (true), catch_up (true: a run missed while the app was closed runs once at start), max_runs, until, timeout_ms, retries (0 to 10), retry_wait (1m), retry_doubling (true), note. A rule: when a schedule ends (done, failed, timed_out, killed, not_done or any), optionally with a result label, a number of times in a row, then start, enable or disable a schedule. See docs/usage.md.

schedules.name: demo_disk_check
schedules.note: Shows free space on / every hour. Turn it on to try it.

schedules.name: demo_morning_ai
schedules.note: Asks the local Ollama model for a line each morning at 08:00, made up once at start if the app was closed then. Ollama must be running.

input.prompt: Write one cheerful sentence to start the day.

schedules.name: demo_month_end
schedules.note: Runs on the last day of each month at 23:00, at most 12 times.

schedules.name: demo_follow_up
schedules.note: Started only by the rule demo_after_failure.

input.script: echo "The disk check failed twice in a row."

rules.name: demo_after_failure
rules.note: When demo_disk_check fails twice in a row, start demo_follow_up. Set enabled to true to try it.
